description: This file defines a feature for listing comments associated with an article, including a query and its handler, using Entity Framework Core for data access.

classes.name: List
classes.description: A container for the comment listing query and its handler.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Represents the request for listing comments for an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the query to retrieve comments for a specific article.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to fetch comments associated with the article slug, throws a RestException if the article is not found.
